title: Final Masses
description: Essential Criteria: The final masses of ice, water, and water vapor must be correctly calculated and presented.

title: Heat Transfer Equation
description: Important Criteria: The application of the heat transfer equation involving latent heats must be correctly set up and used.

title: Mass Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The conservation of mass equation must be correctly formulated and utilized in the solution.

title: Volume Consideration
description: Important Criteria: The consideration of the volume of water vapor compared to ice and water must be addressed.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the calculations, particularly for heat and mass.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Errors in applying the latent heat values or incorrect assumptions about phase changes will lead to significant mistakes.

title: Final Answer Format
description: Optional Criteria: The final answers should be clearly formatted and labeled for clarity.
